title: Add a function to a written spec
prompt: Add a function slugify(text) to src/text.js and export it next to capitalize. Rules: lowercase the text; keep the letters a-z and the digits 0-9; anything else becomes a dash; several dashes in a row become one; no dash at the start or the end. Examples: "  Hello, World!  " gives "hello-world", and "Node.js 24 is out" gives "node-js-24-is-out".
